fusions.name: Cast and Bound Away
fusions.desc: Throws a light javelin that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Twelve-Tine Toss
fusions.desc: Throws 4 tines at once in a spread out to 6 tiles; each deals 9 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Haft's Length
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick to Recover
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
